author: CuriousPanCake
title: Windows CC build fails with compiler/linker out-of-memory errors under high parallelism
signature: Windows Release build runs out of memory - compiler fatal error C1060 (out of heap space) and linker fatal error LNK1102 (out of memory) under high parallelism|Infrastructure

failed_jobs.name: Build_And_Run_Collect_Mode
failed_jobs.symptom: ninja build fails: c1xx fatal error C1356 (unable to find mspdbcore.dll) on cosh.cpp.obj, then link of hello_classification.exe fails with LNK1102 out of memory

failed_jobs.name: ci/gha_overall_status_windows_cc
failed_jobs.symptom: Aggregate status check fails (exit 1) because Build_And_Run_Collect_Mode failed

key_errors: c1xx: fatal error C1356: unable to find mspdbcore.dll
LINK : fatal error LNK1102: out of memory
root_cause: The Windows Conditional Compilation (CC) build runs with CMAKE_BUILD_PARALLEL_LEVEL=31 on a shared runner. Under this high parallelism, the MSVC toolchain's shared PDB/debug-info server (mspdb*.dll) and linker run out of memory/resources mid-build: the compiler fails to load mspdbcore.dll (C1356) and shortly after the linker fails with LNK1102 (out of memory) while linking hello_classification.exe. This is the same recurring Windows CC resource-exhaustion pattern recorded 13 times previously (pattern 80cfa127185fbf3e), not caused by the PagedSparseAttentionFusion change in PR #39412.
reproduction_steps: Not reliably reproducible outside CI; requires a Windows runner with similarly constrained memory and CMAKE_BUILD_PARALLEL_LEVEL=31 building the full OpenVINO Release CC configuration with ninja + MSVC 14.42 + ccache. Locally, building with a high -j parallelism on a memory-constrained Windows machine can trigger the same C1356/LNK1102 errors.
recommended_actions: Reduce CMAKE_BUILD_PARALLEL_LEVEL for the Windows CC job or switch to a runner with more memory/cores ratio
Consider disabling /MP or ccache's parallel PDB writing conflicts (CMAKE_CXX_COMPILER_LAUNCHER=ccache + /Z7 vs /Zi) to reduce concurrent mspdbsrv.exe contention
Add retry-on-link-failure logic or increase linker/debug server timeout for transient PDB-server contention
Track recurrence of pattern 80cfa127185fbf3e (13+ occurrences) and escalate to infra team for runner sizing review
prevention_strategies: Right-size CMAKE_BUILD_PARALLEL_LEVEL to the runner's actual memory budget; monitor runner memory pressure during Windows Release builds; consider /Zi vs /Z7 to avoid mspdbsrv serialization bottlenecks under high parallelism.
historical_context: This exact signature (compiler C1060/C1356 PDB-server issues plus linker LNK1102 out-of-memory under high parallelism on the Windows CC build) has recurred 13 times since 2026-11-03, most recently on 2026-11-19 (runs 44599895950, 44588231549, 44581373590, and others). It is a known, unresolved Windows CC infrastructure resource-exhaustion issue unrelated to specific code changes.
